fields.note: Public CareerPosition/Details body accepts department (exact name) or departmentCode; a department=Software request returned 0 of 15 rows at inspection, so the value must match the current portal exactly.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: The listing filter takes locationId/preferredLocationId; no public name-to-ID map was exposed, so locations are empty.

notes: Addverb's official careers CTA (hr1.to/9c16d2) opens the public hrone career portal. POST /api/external/public/referral/CareerPosition/Details with the portal's appId/domainCode returns the full current requisition list; the same body accepts jobTitle (title/keyword search, not separately exercised) and department (tested). Keyword/department are native; remaining fields are filtered locally.
